qualification.education_qualification: 10th pass from any recognised board; valid driving licence issued by the transport officer
qualification.details: Qualification: 10th pass from any recognised board; Valid driving licence issued by the transport officer | Other conditions: | Domicile certificate issued by the competent authority to be attached | Desirable: | Mechanic qualification (form asks for supporting documents, if any)

how_to_apply: Obtain the application form from the DLSA office at A.D.R. Bhawan, District Court Campus, Vidisha, or from the websites of the MP High Court, MP State Legal Services Authority or Principal District and Sessions Judge Vidisha.
Fill the form, paste a photograph and sign across it.
Attach self-attested photocopies of the listed documents.
Submit by post or in person at the DLSA office, Vidisha by 25-11-2026, 05:00 PM.
important_instructions: All document copies must be self-attested and submitted physically Details of any pending criminal case must be given in the form Candidature may be cancelled at any stage if information is found false

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Aadhaar card and PAN card Marksheets of Class 5, 8 and 10 Caste certificate Domicile certificate Valid driving licence issued by the transport officer Previous experience documents and certificates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Vidisha Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form from the DLSA office at A.D.R. Bhawan, District Court Campus, Vidisha, or from the websites of the MP High Court, MP State Legal Services Authority or Principal District and Sessions Judge Vidisha. Fill the form, paste a photograph and sign across it. Attach self-attested photocopies of the listed documents. Submit by post or in person at the DLSA office, Vidisha by 25-11-2026, 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: All document copies must be self-attested and submitted physically Details of any pending criminal case must be given in the form Candidature may be cancelled at any stage if information is found false
